output.summary: KEP-1733 (Release Notes Improvements) is recorded as implemented at stage stable. The readme describes a new release notes process and a website for filtering release notes, with a two-phase goal list where most items are checked off.
output.rationale: The readme says the change is "a visible change large enough to warrant a KEP" and lists consolidation and automation goals, most checked as done. The discussion does not discuss KEP-1733's own status; it concerns a batch status update (PR #3007) that moved many KEPs to implemented and the rule that implemented requires stage stable. The sources do not explain the specific reason KEP-1733 was set to implemented beyond that batch update.

alternatives.option: Keep the KEP at implementable (not implemented)
alternatives.why_not: The sources do not discuss this option for KEP-1733; the discussion concerns general rules for marking KEPs implemented, and the reviewers agreed on a rule that implemented pairs with stage stable.

alternatives.option: Mark implemented without a PRR file
alternatives.why_not: Reviewers noted that moving KEPs to implemented without a PRR file caused CI failures and that a PRR file was added for PR #3007, though the sources do not explicitly say KEP-1733 got a PRR file.

evidence.quote: While this change would only affect the release-notes team, this is a visible change large enough to warrant a KEP.
It landed after https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/2672 (which made PRR required for implementable), but since it landed as implemented, it skipped PRR
This KEP was initially declared implementable at alpha, before PRR was required. The retroactive PR incorrectly called this "implemented" at beta, so it skipped PRR this cycle.
Now failing because https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/2939 moved a KEP to implemented without the corresponding PRR file
